prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: final approved-direction candidate comp for the Sevilla360 interface
Input images: Image 1 is the source for the homepage/guest-facing half; Image 2 is the source for the dashboard/Operate half.
Primary request: Create one seamless 16:9 split-screen UI comp. Preserve the homepage from Image 1 exactly in its Cinematic Tropical Premium treatment: dark botanical evening background, clearly visible top navigation, the same headline, same CTA placement, and the exact homepage layout. Preserve the dashboard from Image 2 exactly in its Refined Editorial Luxury treatment: warm ivory workspace, dark ink navigation, editorial serif Command Center heading, restrained gold and sage accents, KPI cards, schedule, and recent bookings. Join them cleanly at the existing vertical boundary as one intentional two-mode Sevilla360 system.
Text (verbatim where visible): "SEVILLA360", "M.I. Sevilla", "Where Every Event Becomes A Memory", "BOOK YOUR STAY", "EXPLORE RESORT", "Command Center", "Monthly Revenue", "Action Required", "Arrivals Today", "Today's Occupancy".
Constraints: change only the selected halves and seam; keep both source layouts, typography character, content hierarchy, and UI structure unchanged; straight-on desktop UI; no device frame; no annotations; no new decorative motifs; no invented claims; production-ready visual fidelity.
Avoid: blending the dark homepage styling into the dashboard work surface, making the dashboard dark, lightening the homepage, changing the homepage topology, text glitches, watermarks.
